about_the_game:
ReSetna is an action-packed metroidvania focused on fast paced combat with parry mechanics, a unique upgrade system and stunning visuals.

Upgrade System - Chips

In ReSetna, power is in your hands with the Chip Upgrade System: a modular, Tetris-inspired grid that lets you refine your abilities, weapons, and survival skills. Slot chips to enhance your combat prowess, movement, defense, and hacking abilities, adapting your playstyle to any challenge.

  • Weapon Chips: Unlock devastating attacks for the axe, naginata, and sword, from lightning arcs to piercing strikes and ranged slashes.

  • Ability Chips: Gain an edge in mobility and defense, with upgrades like precision wall jumps, explosive dodges, and reinforced shields.

  • General Chips: Boost health, regenerate after taking damage, or unleash shocking counterattacks when struck.

  • Hack Chips: Manipulate enemies with chain lightning, detonate foes remotely, or reduce cooldowns for quicker cyber warfare. 

Experiment with chip placement to unlock powerful synergies, customize your loadout, and take down the corrupted machines that stand in your way. Upgrade your chip tiers by combining chips of the same color, and maximize their potential by ensuring more chips of the same color are connected together.

Story

In a world where organic life has long since perished, ReSetna is awakened by APEX AI to confront the growing threat of the mysterious Signal. As the Signal spreads chaos, disrupting the balance of the world and driving robots to madness, ReSetna, a combat-ready robot with advanced technology, must uncover the truth behind this disturbance and eliminate the Signal’s influence. With her loyal drone companion IXA, ReSetna traverses a crumbling world, piecing together the secrets of Project Ascendance while battling fierce enemies and uncovering a dark history.

  • Explore a Rich, Post-Apocalyptic World: From the haunting remnants of Polis_13 to the toxic expanses of Acidia, journey through distinct, dystopian zones, each filled with secrets, unique challenges, and lore, inviting deep exploration and discovery.

  • Rich Narrative and Lore: Piece together clues to discover the complicated history of this enigmatic world. Each zone holds keys to the past and hints of the future, through environmental storytelling and cryptic communications.

  • Fast-Paced Combat: Engage with a wide array of enemies in each zone. Each will challenge you to adapt your strategy and refine your combat skills. Tactical thinking is key to mastering ReSetna’s arsenal and overcoming adversaries.

  • Dynamic Companion – IXA: IXA, your loyal drone companion, will be an essential aid, providing healing in critical moments and hacking enemies.

  • Epic Boss Battles: The ultimate test of your skills! Each formidable boss is an epic, intense showdown requiring a sound strategy to beat. Their unique abilities will require you stay on your toes, exploit their weaknesses, and leverage upgrades to survive.

  • Upgrade Your Abilities: A customizable chip-upgrade system lets you customize ReSetna to suit your playstyle. Whether enhancing her combat techniques or her abilities to manipulate her environment, your choices affect her evolution and how you overcome obstacles.

  • 7 Demanding Districts: Every environment presents a challenging terrain demanding keen observation and platforming abilities. You'll encounter mechanisms and hazards, as well as opportunities to uncover hidden rooms and secret passages that offer unique rewards and deeper insight into the world's history.

pegi.descriptors: The game contains depictions of violence. In games rated PEGI 7 this can only be non-realistic or non-detailed violence.

reviews:
“As a huge fan of Metroidvanias, Resetna has definitely piqued my interest. The game’s clean visuals, visceral combat, and intriguing narrative have me ready to bust up some bots and silence that Signal, whatever the cost!”
Gamer Social Club

“I liked piecing together the game's lore, and I loved how Radiant Blades' chip transformed the latter half of the game into an overpowered run-and-gun spectacle.”
Metroidvania Guru

“ReSetna offers a simpler, more dynamic experience that focuses on fast-paced action and exploration. The exploration aspect of the game is particularly well-crafted, with traversal mechanics like dashing, air-dashing, double jumping, wall jumping, and teleporting between checkpoints, all of which you unlock as you progress.”
Indie Games
short_description: SYSTEMS IMPROVED! ReSetna is a combat oriented action-platformer. Battle Signal-hacked robots called Optigens, test your skill in epic boss fights and explore seven challenging zones! Customize your playstyle with a Tetris-inspired upgrade system to create powerful abilities.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
